description: Create a new document or spreadsheet and open it in the MR Office editor for the person to see and edit. A document's content is Markdown (headings, lists, tables, emphasis); a spreadsheet's is CSV. `format` is the file it is exported as by default (docx or md for documents, csv for spreadsheets).

content.description: Markdown for a document, CSV for a spreadsheet

name: create_document
title: Create a document
